document.name: Tiger Schulmann's New Dorp Kids Karate
document.address: 363 New Dorp Lane, Staten Island, NY 10306
document.shortDescription: Curriculum-based kids karate in New Dorp with preschool Cubs starting at age 3, plus broader youth martial arts and a free beginner session.
document.longDescription:
Tiger Schulmann's official New Dorp kids karate page says the Staten Island school helps children of all ages build fitness, confidence, and lasting discipline through martial arts. The same official kids overview says the Cubs preschool program begins at age 3, while the New Dorp school page describes curriculum-based karate classes that help children grow through structured achievements and coaching under Shihan John Delaney.

The official New Dorp pages list the school at 363 New Dorp Lane, Staten Island, NY 10306 with contact phone 718-635-1416 and email statenisland@tsk.com. The indexed official kids and location pages also publish a location-hours block of Monday-Friday 10:00 AM-9:30 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM-2:00 PM, and Sunday closed, which supports weekday, weekend, morning, afternoon, and evening availability for the school.

Tiger's official kids page promotes a free beginner class described as a 1-hour private beginner session for new families. The listing image is an ImgBB re-host of a Tiger-branded youth martial arts class photo used in the organization's current web build.

Sources: https://tsk.com/kids/karate/staten-island-new-dorp/ https://tsk.com/locations/ny/staten-island-new-dorp/ https://tsk.com/kids/karate/ https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/681b74041b3ab04738836a94/681cfa2a31adefd02d1793a0_0039-tsk.JPG
